column1: # Cue words for context-cued numbers (languages/cues.py, LAB-1170).
# cue <TAB> entity type of the number right after it, or "-" for a cue that names something
# (a third column "after" marks a cue that follows its value: "a 06 30 123 4567 számon");
# that is not personal data, or a word that hands the window on ("and"): a "-" cue ends the
# window, so the number after it is never masked by an earlier cue.
# Case and accents are ignored; a space also matches a hyphen or nothing; a trailing "*"
# lets the word take suffixes (kártyaszámát, telefonszámom). Every pack's cues run for every
# text; the text's own language wins a cue two packs map differently.
# Cues after the value (third column "after", LAB-1199): "a +36 30 123 4567 számon",
# "a KA652524 számú útlevelére". A bare "számú" names nothing ("a 4500123456 számú
# szerződés"), so it is a cue only with its noun; a phone before one needs a + or 0 prefix.
